decision.b: Before the full build, one question has to be settled with Grace and counsel. The 23 Oct handoff says Grace has no licensed clinician or pharmacy and asked for a research-use-only store. Everything built since assumes a clinician-guided service, and Health Canada says selling these peptides as "research use only" to people is not legal.

opts.b: Grace partners with a licensed telehealth clinician and a licensed pharmacy. The site sells the consult. This is the strongest model for hooks, the guided tour and long-term trust, and it is what the master prompt assumes.

opts.t: LAUNCH WITH WHAT IS CLEARLY ALLOWED, ADD THE CLINIC LATER
opts.b: Open with the lead magnet (newsletter, waitlist, the guide), the cosmetic topical range, and the brand experience. Collect a list now and switch the consult on the day a clinician partner is signed.

Not recommended. Health Canada treats this as selling unauthorized drugs. A site with personal goals, a guided tour and hooks would contradict the "research only" label, and payment processors and ad platforms routinely shut these stores down. I would not build hooks that sell these products for personal use.
